long_biography.plain_text:
After earning an economics degree from the University of Pennsylvania, Hochfelder helped establish Brahman Capital, a New York investment partnership built around concentrated public-equity research. As a managing member and executive officer, he shared authority over fund holdings and portfolio decisions, making his role operational as well as financial.

He retired from Brahman in 2016 and shifted towards private investing and board work. At TIC Solutions, he sits on the audit committee and chairs compensation, drawing on the investment and governance experience accumulated across almost three decades. He has also served on the boards of homelessness organisation HELP USA, veterans charity Brothers for Life and the Community-Police Relations Foundation.
